title: Cross-sectional resilience after BTC deleveraging shocks with scoped metrics conflicts

provenance.reason_for_new_id: Both predecessors failed before PnL on metrics timestamp structure
provenance.data_rule_change: normalize lag <=10s; never select among duplicate snapshots; mark the symbol-time ambiguous

overrides.data.metrics_timestamp_semantics: create_time lag from 0 through 10000ms is normalized down to its 5m period boundary
overrides.data.metrics_collision_semantics: all normalized duplicates become ambiguous; ambiguous, missing or non-positive required OI excludes that symbol from that event
overrides.portfolio.insufficient_valid_symbols_pol: fail the entire experiment if any frozen event has fewer than 12 valid symbols; never skip the event
overrides.interpretation.special_caveat: data rules were selected after structural inspection but before any H3 portfolio or PnL
